source: ECharts 6.1 dist (echarts.js), node SSR, SVG renderer
notes: Every option has animation false; the clock is fake.
The brush preprocessor adds a toolbox with the brush feature (C18): no step points at it.
brushSelect is recorded apart (selects): when it ran and the areas it carried; its selected data is C18.
A step naming a piece points at its shape centre (rounded) plus dx / dy, read just before the step.

scenarios.note: a rect on a category grid: the crosshair, the cover, its cursors over the main shape and the eight handles
the main shape dragged inside the grid, then past its right and bottom edges: the range leaves the panel, the shapes are clipped
each of the eight handles dragged in turn; the west handle past the east edge swaps them
single mode: a second rect replaces the first; a tiny drag clears (removeOnClick); a click on a cover ends a brush
a drag of exactly 6 px draws nothing, 7 px does; a press outside the grid draws nothing; a drag leaving the canvas
multiple mode: three rects, the later on top; a tiny drag removes nothing; switching to single keeps the covers until a new one
a polygon: every move a vertex, clipped to the grid; dragged; replaced in single mode; cleared by a tiny drag
lineX on a value x axis: the cover spans the grid height; its two handles; dragged
lineY on a category y axis (horizontal bars): the cover spans the grid width
no finder: the global panel -- not clipped, no coordRange; a global lineX spans the canvas; a tiny drag clears
two grids, xAxisIndex 'all': a drag in the right grid clipped to it; then one in the left grid replaces it
the brush action lays covers from coordRange (rect, lineX, polygon) and from a pixel range (global); dragged while the brush is off; fewer areas; none
a cover kept by the model: a merge that rescales the y axis lays it again at the size ratio; a release away from the last move leaves the model at the move's range
brushStyle, transformable false, removeOnClick false: no handles, no move cursor, a press on the cover draws anew, a tiny drag keeps
a 10 px border: the handles take the line width; a brushOption of its own (transformable kept, mode multiple)
the brush switched off (brushType false, then another key): the covers stay and still move; no crosshair, no drawing
throttleType fixRate, 300 ms: brushSelect runs at once, then at lastExec + 300 with the latest areas
throttleType debounce, 250 ms: brushSelect only after the moves stop

guards.mutation: the handle size is the line width, not at least 6
the drift of the 'n' edge adds dx
a global line cover's other extent is the canvas' other side
the round trip ignores the size ratio
fixRate measured from the last call, not the last run
